step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram shows two AWS accounts/environments: 'AWS DATA' on the left and 'AWS USER PRO' on the right, separated by a dashed line with VPC Peering in between.

1. External users interact with S3 (AWS USER PRO) directly to upload files using pre-signed URLs.
2. S3 triggers an event sent to SQS.
3. EKS in AWS USER PRO listens to/processes messages from SQS.
4. SQS feeds jobs/messages to an Auto Scaling Group (ASG) of processing EC2 instances.
5. On the AWS DATA side, S3 holds data that feeds into EKS (AWS DATA).
6. EKS (AWS DATA) communicates securely via VPC Peering with EKS (AWS USER PRO).
